```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data <- tibble(country = c("US", "Canada", "Mexico", "UK"))
data
```

```{r}
data %>% mutate(
  (country == "Canada"),               # OK.
  (country == c("Mexico", "Canada")),  # DON'T DO THIS!
  (country == c("Canada", "Mexico")),  # THIS IS WHY
  (country %in% c("Canada", "Mexico")) # DO THIS INSTEAD
) %>% knitr::kable()
```
